2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona tests its wounded depth against Herbert’s quick-strike Chargers offense
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona enters SoFi with Jeremiyah Love expected to play through an ankle issue, but the Cardinals still face a difficult assignment against Justin Herbert and Mike McDaniel’s new offense. Los Angeles has emphasized quicker throws and yards after catch, while its pass rush can stress Arizona if the Cardinals fall behind the chains. Arizona’s best counter is sustained early-down efficiency and pressure that prevents Herbert from comfortably attacking explosive windows downfield.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles has the cleaner offensive structure if Herbert stays on schedule, while Arizona needs efficient early downs and disruptive pressure to keep the matchup compressed.
